body.problem: Builders need a curated, traceable body of reusable guidance covering visual style, layout, color and interaction across web and native mobile. Unversioned and unattributed advice makes design decisions hard to reproduce or review. This epic specifies new corpus-domain behavior; it does not assert that generic retrieval, workflow or artifact infrastructure is absent. Existing infrastructure reuse remains an HLD investigation, bounded by the analyzer results recorded in the implementation plan. [[c3]]

summary.prose: Provide reviewed, reusable design knowledge for web, iOS and Android. Each recommendation explains its fit and preserves its source, version and reuse terms. All story criteria below specify required future behavior, not claims of implemented APIs or stored records.

nonGoals.rationale: DI2 owns project identity, persistence and activation; DI3 owns authoring and reuse workflows. [[c8]] [[c9]]
The product establishes reusable project guidelines.

nonGoals.text: Copy UI UX Pro Max catalogs
nonGoals.rationale: It is inspiration only, as explicitly recorded in the PRD. [[c10]]

assumptions.text: Candidate sources may support the seed corpus, but neither file-level eligibility nor sufficient cross-platform coverage is established. Story s2 must produce the eligibility inventory and s3 must prove reviewed coverage before publication; gaps require original authored guidance or additional eligible sources, never assumed completeness.

constraints.text: Only eligible open-source/open-licensed material enters distributed corpus; retain exact provenance, notices and modifications.
Cover Web, Mobile-iOS and Mobile-Android without framework dependence; corpus updates never silently change approved project decisions. Historical evidence remains pinned. [[c13]]

Daemon owns persistence; embeddings local; cloud LLM access through CLI providers only; provider calls sequential and accuracy governs critical reasoning. These are inherited architectural requirements for the new capability. [[c5]] [[c6]] [[c7]]

stories.title: Inspect complete attributable design guidance
stories.userValue: Curators and agents can understand applicability and reuse conditions. This story introduces the corpus record contract from PRD entry requirements; exact schema and identity mechanics are HLD decisions. [[c11]]

acceptanceCriteria.given: a proposed foundation, pattern or style recipe
acceptanceCriteria.then: missing provenance, examples, applicability or review status prevents publication
stable identity, version, relationships, rationale and source lineage are visible

stories.title: Admit only eligible material from pinned sources
stories.userValue: Maintainers can safely assemble reproducible releases.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a source with eligible and unknown-license files
acceptanceCriteria.then: only eligible files are admitted and their exact revisions, attribution and modifications are retained
all included third-party material has the required license and attribution records

functionalRequirements.statement: Admit only eligible material from pinned sources

stories.title: Use reviewed guidance across web and native mobile
stories.userValue: Builders can choose coherent styles for each supported UI type.

acceptanceCriteria.then: a reviewed coverage inventory demonstrates guidance for each of Web, Mobile-iOS and Mobile-Android across the PRD domains: Visual style; Layout; Color; Typography; Navigation and flows; Components and states; Motion and feedback; Inclusive design; Platform adaptation; Content and trust. Interaction guidance includes navigation, components and motion; accessibility guidance is included in Inclusive design. [[c12]]

acceptanceCriteria.when: it has not received editorial review
acceptanceCriteria.then: it is not presented as published source-authored guidance

functionalRequirements.statement: Use reviewed guidance across web and native mobile

stories.title: Find applicable guidance with traceable reasons
stories.userValue: Agents obtain relevant evidence without inventing matches. This story introduces daemon-routed corpus retrieval under the existing daemon-owns-DB rule; it does not claim an existing corpus IPC handler. [[c2]]

acceptanceCriteria.then: results state applicability, caveats, fit rationale and pinned evidence through the daemon
an explicit gap is returned instead of fabricated recommendations

functionalRequirements.statement: Find applicable guidance with traceable reasons

stories.title: Update corpus releases without changing project decisions
stories.userValue: Maintainers can improve knowledge while preserving reproducibility.

acceptanceCriteria.given: an upstream content or license change
acceptanceCriteria.then: eligibility and editorial review precede publication and affected records can be deprecated or withdrawn

acceptanceCriteria.given: a consumer holding an immutable release ID and record-version references for corpus release N
acceptanceCriteria.then: resolving the pinned references still returns the same release-N evidence and never substitutes N+1; approved project decisions remain unchanged. DI1 supplies stable historical evidence; DI2 stores the guideline references and tests project activation isolation. Withdrawal is explicit and must not silently substitute content. [[c13]]

functionalRequirements.statement: Update corpus releases without changing project decisions

requirements.statement: Users find reviewed guidance appropriate to their platform and constraints, with explicit gaps and source-linked rationale.
Published knowledge remains attributable and reproducible across corpus revisions.
Admit only eligible material from pinned sources
Use reviewed guidance across web and native mobile
Find applicable guidance with traceable reasons
Update corpus releases without changing project decisions

citations.quotedText: Repository licenses identify candidates; individual files and bundled assets must still pass the ingestion requirements before inclusion. No sources have been imported by this PRD.
Daemon owns all DB access — CLI, MCP, and the IDE workbench communicate via IPC only.
DI1 Open source design corpus and retrieval
covers both web and mobile ... focuses on designing rather than React, Angular, or any other implementation framework
Accuracy is primary; cost is the least priority.
Never Promise.all anything that reaches an LLM provider ... always serial for...of with sequential awaits.
embeddings are local-only ... Cloud LLM access goes through CliProvider
DI2 Project guideline identity and versioned lifecycle
DI3 Guideline creation revision and agent reuse
UI UX Pro Max is an inspiration and reference; its implementation and catalog will not be copied.
Each published entry must have a stable identifier, version, title, domain, guidance type, applicability, and independently authored explanation.
Existing project decisions remain tied to their original evidence; a new corpus release produces suggested revisions and never silently redesigns a project.
Unknown, absent, conflicting, or restrictive terms block distribution of the affected material until resolved.
